name: wolf pelt
blurb: A rough northern pelt, still cold from the Frostmere Wilds. The guild will take these.
effects: Trade goods. Eirik counts them toward his pelt task.

name: wolf tooth
blurb: A small whole tooth. Brenna will pay a little and no more.
effects: Trade goods.

name: cracked fang
blurb: Longer than a tooth has any right to be, split near the root.
effects: Trade goods. Worth more than a common tooth.

name: stringy meat
blurb: A strip of wolf. Edible only in the sense that it is not a rock.
effects: Not fit to eat. Sell it.

name: wool bandage
blurb: Clean wool, folded tight. It stays on if you do not fuss with it.
effects: Restores 10 health.

name: trail ration
blurb: Salt, fat, and a hard biscuit. The cheapest meal that still counts as food.
effects: Restores 18 health.

name: worn woodsman's axe
blurb: The edge is honest, if tired. It has cut more firewood than wolves.
effects: Melee. A slow, heavy chop.

name: bearded handaxe
blurb: Shorter haft, keener bite, quicker back to the guard.
effects: Melee. The beard of the blade hooks a little harder.

name: ash staff
blurb: A walking staff with an iron-shod tip. A poor axe, and a fair focus.
effects: Melee. Also a focus for Shardbolt and Rimefield.

name: yarrow draught
blurb: A bitter green drink in a clay flask. It costs. It also puts you back on your feet.
effects: Restores 36 health.

name: wolf helm
blurb: The wolf's snout sits on your brow. Its open mouth frames your face.
effects: Worn on the head. The hide turns a light blow.

name: bone staff
blurb: A femur-straight staff capped with a drilled knuckle. Shamans like the balance.
effects: Melee. A focus for shaman spells.

name: skinning knife
blurb: Short, mean, and happier in a back than a front.
effects: Melee. Fast. A rogue weapon.

name: paired hatchets
blurb: Two short axes on one belt. They want rage more than polish.
effects: Melee. A berserker pair, worn as one weapon.

name: hand wraps
blurb: Linen beaten into the knuckles. A warden weapon, not a glove.
effects: Melee. Fists. Fast and light.

name: sundering chop
blurb: Eirik's drill for a chop that hates armor.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: breaker swing
blurb: The guild's heavy lesson. Two beats, one motion.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: gale hex
blurb: Torunn's wind, written so the hand remembers.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: ancestor ward
blurb: A ward the old blood will answer, if you are far enough along.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: poisoned blade
blurb: Sable's recipe. The cut is the small part.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: vanish
blurb: How to leave a fight without winning it.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: execution
blurb: Hroth's last chop. It wants a full rage.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: blood feast
blurb: Turn rage into blood. Not a gentle page.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: bear heart
blurb: Bjorn's borrowed nerve. The blows get heavier.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: deep mend
blurb: A slower knit than the first mend.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: glacier spike
blurb: A wizard page. Barbarians are not taught it.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.

name: whiteout
blurb: A wizard page for a storm of snow.
effects: Training. Buying it teaches the ability if you are the right class and level.
